title: The Nuclear Salt Water Rocket - Possibly the Craziest Rocket Engine Ever Imagined.
summary: Scott Manley explains the nuclear salt water rocket, Robert Zubrin's concept of a rocket fueled by a rapid nuclear reaction in uranium salt dissolved in water. He covers its extraordinary performance and the dangers of managing it.
why: HN points to it as the go-to accessible video whenever nuclear rocket engines come up.

quote.text: Scott Manley does a great video talking about nuclear rocket engines[2]
